subproblem.title: Change of variables for τ(M, θ, ξ) under a dilation
subproblem.statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, ξ : ℝ^N → NVector(ℝ^N, k), and let ω be any k-form on ℝ^N (DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k, with no regularity or support assumption). Put φ(x) := ρ • x, μ := μHE[k] and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k). Assume (H1) φ is a measurable embedding and (H2) φ is measure preserving from c • μ to μ. Then τ(M, θ, ξ) tested against x ↦ ρ^k ω(ρx) equals τ(φ(M), θ(ρ⁻¹·), ξ(ρ⁻¹·)) tested against ω: tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω. Here tauAction k S ϑ ζ α = ∫_{x ∈ S} ϑ(x)·ζ(x)(α(x)) dμ is a Bochner set integral, equal to 0 when the integrand is not integrable.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x : Eucl N => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Steps 0(b) and 1. Here the measure facts come from the hypotheses (H1) and (H2); the parent discharges them with the sibling deformation_dilation_hausdorff. No sibling is used here.

Conventions.
- ℝ^N := Eucl N, μ := μHE[k], φ(x) := ρ • x and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k).
- M′ := φ(M), θ′(y) := θ(ρ⁻¹ • y) and ξ′(y) := ξ(ρ⁻¹ • y).
- (★) ρ⁻¹ • φ(x) = x for every x (inv_smul_smul₀, ρ ≠ 0). Hence θ′(φ x) = θ(x) and ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x).
- Unfold tauAction on both sides. The left side is ∫_{x ∈ M} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x). The right side is ∫_{y ∈ M′} θ′(y)·ξ′(y)(ω(y)) dμ(y).

1. Change of variables. For every g : ℝ^N → ℝ and every S ⊆ ℝ^N,
   ∫_{y ∈ φ(S)} g(y) dμ(y) = ∫_{x ∈ S} g(φ x) d(c • μ)(x).
   This is MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb applied to (H2), (H1), g and S. The identity of Bochner integrals needs no integrability hypothesis. It comes from the restriction of φ being a measure-preserving measurable embedding from (c • μ)|_S to μ|_{φ S}, for which ∫ g ∘ φ = ∫ g holds for every g (MeasurePreserving.integral_comp with a measurable embedding).

2. Scalar factor. (c • μ)|_S = c • (μ|_S) (Measure.restrict_smul), and ∫ h d(c • ν) = c.toReal·∫ h dν (integral_smul_measure). Also c.toReal = ρ^k, because ρ^k ≥ 0 (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal; nonnegativity by positivity or pow_nonneg hρ.le k). Hence ∫_{φ(S)} g dμ = ρ^k·∫_{x ∈ S} g(φ x) dμ(x).

3. Right side. Apply Steps 1–2 to g(y) := θ′(y)·ξ′(y)(ω(y)) and S := M:
   tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω = ∫_{φ(M)} g dμ
   = ρ^k·∫_{x ∈ M} θ′(ρ • x)·ξ′(ρ • x)(ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x)
   = ∫_{x ∈ M} ρ^k·(θ′(ρ • x)·ξ′(ρ • x)(ω(ρ • x))) dμ(x) (integral_const_mul, read right to left).

4. Pointwise comparison. Fix x. By (★), θ′(ρ • x) = θ(x) and ξ′(ρ • x) = ξ(x). Since ξ(x) is linear, ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x)) (map_smul, smul_eq_mul). So the left integrand θ(x)·ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = θ(x)·(ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x))). This equals the Step 3 integrand ρ^k·(θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x))) (ring).

5. Conclusion. The two set integrals over M have equal integrands at every point (congr; funext). Hence tauAction k M θ ξ (x ↦ ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω. ∎

theorem Submission.deformation_dilation_im_tauAction : ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x : Eucl N => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω := by
  intro N k ρ M θ ξ ω hρ hemb hmp
  simp only [tauAction]
  rw [hmp.setIntegral_image_emb hemb (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y) * ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y) (ω y)) M,
    Measure.restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity),
    smul_eq_mul, ← integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp only [inv_smul_smul₀ hρ.ne', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring
proof_key_steps: ∫_{φ(S)} g dμ = ∫_S g ∘ φ d(c • μ) for all g and S (MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb with (H1) and (H2); no integrability needed).
(c • μ)|_S = c • μ|_S, and ∫ h d(c • ν) = c.toReal·∫ h dν with c.toReal = ρ^k (restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure, toReal_ofReal).
Apply this to g = θ′·ξ′(·)(ω(·)) on S = M and move ρ^k inside the integral (integral_const_mul).
Pointwise, θ′(ρx) = θ(x) and ξ′(ρx) = ξ(x) (inv_smul_smul₀), and ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρx)) = ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρx)) (map_smul); finish with ring and congr/funext.

subproblem.title: Dilation invariance of weighted approximate tangent spaces
subproblem.statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, let M ⊆ ℝ^N (Eucl N), θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N, and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^N. Suppose Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.7 (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q). Then Q is a weighted approximate tangent space of the dilated pair (ρM, θ(ρ⁻¹·)) at ρx, where ρM = {ρz : z ∈ M}. In Lean: HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k ((fun y => ρ • y) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (ρ • x) Q.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (x : Eucl N) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k ((fun y : Eucl N => ρ • y) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (ρ • x) Q
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Step 4 (weighted tangent transport), specialized and made self-contained. No sibling is used.

Conventions.
- ℝ^N := Eucl N and μ := μHE[k], the Hausdorff measure H^k on ℝ^N.
- M′ := (fun y => ρ • y) '' M = {ρ • z : z ∈ M} and θ′(y) := θ(ρ⁻¹ • y).
- blowUpMap p s w := s⁻¹ • (w − p). This is Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap, Simon's η_{p,s}. It is not opened in the contract scope, so write it fully qualified.
- Definition (SimonGMT Chapter03.Rectifiable; Simon Ch. 3, 1.7). HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k S ϑ p Q means:
  (A) finrank ℝ Q = k, and
  (B) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), the function J(S, ϑ, p, f)(s) := ∫_{u ∈ blowUpMap p s '' S} f(u)·ϑ(p + s • u) dμ(u) tends to ϑ(p)·∫_{u ∈ Q} f(u) dμ(u) as s → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0.
- From ρ > 0 we get ρ ≠ 0 and ρ⁻¹ > 0 (inv_pos).
- Let hQ denote the hypothesis HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q.

1. Dimension. Part (A) for (M′, θ′, ρ • x, Q) says finrank Q = k. This is part (A) of hQ.

2. New weight at the new point. θ′(ρ • x) = θ(ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x)) = θ(x), because ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x) = x for ρ ≠ 0 (inv_smul_smul₀).

3. Blow-up sets. Claim: for every real s, blowUpMap (ρ • x) s '' M′ = blowUpMap x (ρ⁻¹·s) '' M.
   By Set.image_image, the left side is the image of M under z ↦ s⁻¹ • (ρ • z − ρ • x). By Set.image_congr it suffices to show, for each z ∈ M,
   s⁻¹ • (ρ • z − ρ • x) = (ρ⁻¹·s)⁻¹ • (z − x).
   Left side: ρ • z − ρ • x = ρ • (z − x) (smul_sub), and s⁻¹ • (ρ • (z − x)) = (s⁻¹·ρ) • (z − x) (smul_smul).
   Right side: (ρ⁻¹·s)⁻¹ = s⁻¹·(ρ⁻¹)⁻¹ = s⁻¹·ρ (mul_inv_rev, inv_inv).
   These field identities hold under Lean's convention 0⁻¹ = 0, so the equality holds for every s, including s = 0.

4. Weights. For every real s and u ∈ ℝ^N:
   θ′(ρ • x + s • u) = θ(ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x + s • u))
   = θ(ρ⁻¹ • ρ • x + ρ⁻¹ • s • u) (smul_add)
   = θ(x + (ρ⁻¹·s) • u) (inv_smul_smul₀, smul_smul).

5. Integral identity. Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ) and put I(s) := J(M, θ, x, f)(s). For every real s, rewrite the domain of integration by Step 3 and the integrand pointwise by Step 4:
   J(M′, θ′, ρ • x, f)(s) = ∫_{u ∈ blowUpMap x (ρ⁻¹·s) '' M} f(u)·θ(x + (ρ⁻¹·s) • u) dμ(u) = I(ρ⁻¹·s).

6. Reparametrization. Let g(s) := ρ⁻¹·s. Then g tends from 𝓝[>] 0 to 𝓝[>] 0:
   (a) g is continuous (continuous_const_mul) and g(0) = ρ⁻¹·0 = 0, so g tends from 𝓝 0 to 𝓝 0. Since 𝓝[>] 0 ≤ 𝓝 0 (nhdsWithin_le_nhds, Tendsto.mono_left), g also tends from 𝓝[>] 0 to 𝓝 0.
   (b) For every s > 0, g(s) = ρ⁻¹·s > 0 (mul_pos with inv_pos.2 hρ). Hence g eventually lands in (0, ∞) along 𝓝[>] 0 (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall).
   (c) By tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff, (a) and (b) give Tendsto g (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[>] 0).

7. Limit. By part (B) of hQ applied to f, I tends to θ(x)·∫_Q f dμ along 𝓝[>] 0. Composing with Step 6 (Tendsto.comp), I ∘ g has the same limit along 𝓝[>] 0. By Step 5, (I ∘ g)(s) = J(M′, θ′, ρ • x, f)(s) for every s (Tendsto.congr). By Step 2, θ(x)·∫_Q f dμ = θ′(ρ • x)·∫_Q f dμ. Hence J(M′, θ′, ρ • x, f) tends to θ′(ρ • x)·∫_Q f dμ along 𝓝[>] 0.

8. Conclusion. Step 1 gives (A). Step 7, for arbitrary f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), gives (B) for (M′, θ′, ρ • x, Q). Therefore HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M′ θ′ (ρ • x) Q. ∎

theorem Submission.deformation_dilation_im_weightedTangent : ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (x : Eucl N) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k ((fun y : Eucl N => ρ • y) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (ρ • x) Q := by
  intro N k ρ M θ x Q hρ hQ
  -- The new multiplicity at `ρ • x` is `θ x`.
  have hval : θ (ρ⁻¹ • ρ • x) = θ x := by rw [inv_smul_smul₀ hρ.ne']
  -- Blow-ups of `ρ M` at `ρ x` with ratio `s` are blow-ups of `M` at `x` with ratio `ρ⁻¹ s`.
  have hset : ∀ s : ℝ,
      Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (ρ • x) s '' ((fun y : Eucl N => ρ • y) '' M) =
        Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x (ρ⁻¹ * s) '' M := by
    intro s
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun z _ => ?_
    simp only [Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap]
    rw [← smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
  have hweight : ∀ (s : ℝ) (u : Eucl N),
      θ (ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x + s • u)) = θ (x + (ρ⁻¹ * s) • u) := by
    intro s u
    rw [smul_add, inv_smul_smul₀ hρ.ne', smul_smul]
  -- `s ↦ ρ⁻¹ s` maps `𝓝[>] 0` to itself.
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * s) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝[>] 0) := by
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ρ⁻¹ * s) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (ρ⁻¹ * 0)) :=
      (continuous_const_mul ρ⁻¹).tendsto 0
    rw [mul_zero] at h0
    exact tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨h0.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun s hs => mul_pos (inv_pos.2 hρ) hs⟩

  show Tendsto _ _ (𝓝 (θ (ρ⁻¹ • ρ • x) * _))

subproblem.title: Dilation invariance of rectifiable triples
subproblem.statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^N → NVector(ℝ^N, k). Put φ(x) := ρ • x, μ := H^k = μHE[k] and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k). Assume (H1) φ is a measurable embedding and (H2) φ is measure preserving from c • μ to μ. If (M, θ, ξ) is a rectifiable triple in ℝ^N (IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ), then so is (φ(M), θ(ρ⁻¹·), ξ(ρ⁻¹·)). In Lean: IsRectifiableTriple univ k ((fun x => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M θ ξ → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Steps 0(a), 0(c), 0(d) and Step 5, fields (i)–(vii). Here the measure facts come from the hypotheses (H1) and (H2), not from the sibling deformation_dilation_hausdorff. Its conclusion is exactly (H1) ∧ (H2), and the parent discharges the hypotheses with it.
Sibling used: weighted_tangent (Submission.deformation_dilation_im_weightedTangent).

Conventions.
- ℝ^N := Eucl N, μ := μHE[k], φ(x) := ρ • x and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k). Note c ≠ ∞ (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).
- M′ := φ(M), θ′(y) := θ(ρ⁻¹ • y) and ξ′(y) := ξ(ρ⁻¹ • y).
- (★) For every x, ρ⁻¹ • φ(x) = x (inv_smul_smul₀, ρ ≠ 0). Hence θ′(φ x) = θ(x), ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x), θ′ ∘ φ = θ and ξ′ ∘ φ = ξ.
- IsRectifiableTriple univ k S ϑ ζ has seven fields:
  subset: S ⊆ univ.
  nullMeasurableSet: S is μ-null measurable.
  countablyRectifiable: CountablyRectifiable k S.
  pos: ϑ > 0 on S.
  integrableOn: for every compact K ⊆ univ, ϑ is μ-integrable on S ∩ K.
  aestronglyMeasurable: ζ is AE strongly measurable for μ|_S.
  orients: for μ|_S-a.e. x there is an orthonormal τ : Fin k → ℝ^N with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k S ϑ x (span(range τ)) and ζ(x) = simpleNVector τ or ζ(x) = −simpleNVector τ.
- Let hT denote the hypothesis IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ.

1. Null sets map to null sets. Claim: if μ(S) = 0 then μ(φ(S)) = 0.
   - By (H2), map φ (c • μ) = μ (MeasurePreserving.map_eq).
   - For the measurable embedding φ of (H1), (map φ ν)(A) = ν(φ⁻¹(A)) for every set A (MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply).
   - φ is injective by (H1), so φ⁻¹(φ(S)) = S (preimage_image_eq).
   Therefore μ(φ S) = (c • μ)(φ⁻¹(φ S)) = (c • μ)(S) = c·μ(S) = c·0 = 0 (Measure.smul_apply, smul_zero).

2. Restricted measures. Claim: φ is measure preserving from c • (μ|_M) to μ|_{M′}.
   First, c • (μ|_M) = (c • μ)|_M (Measure.restrict_smul). Then MeasurePreserving.restrict_image_emb, applied to (H2), (H1) and M, shows φ is measure preserving from (c • μ)|_M to μ|_{φ(M)}. In particular map φ (c • (μ|_M)) = μ|_{M′}.

3. Field subset. M′ ⊆ univ (subset_univ).

4. Field nullMeasurableSet.
   - Let B := toMeasurable μ M. Then B is measurable (measurableSet_toMeasurable).
   - B =ᵐ[μ] M (NullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq applied to hT.nullMeasurableSet). By ae_eq_set this means μ(B ∖ M) = 0 and μ(M ∖ B) = 0.
   - φ(B) is measurable (MeasurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image with (H1)), hence null measurable.
   - By injectivity, φ(B) ∖ φ(M) = φ(B ∖ M) and φ(M) ∖ φ(B) = φ(M ∖ B) (Set.image_sdiff). Both are μ-null by Step 1.
   - So φ(B) =ᵐ[μ] φ(M) (ae_eq_set), and φ(M) is null measurable (NullMeasurableSet.congr).

5. Field countablyRectifiable. From hT.countablyRectifiable obtain M₀ with μ(M₀) = 0 and F : ℕ → (ℝ^k → ℝ^N) such that each F_j is LipschitzWith K_j and M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j range F_j.
   (a) φ is LipschitzWith ‖ρ‖₊, since dist(ρ • a, ρ • b) = ‖ρ‖·dist(a, b) (dist_smul₀; LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul).
   (b) Take M₀′ := φ(M₀), which is μ-null by Step 1. Take F′_j := φ ∘ F_j, which is LipschitzWith (‖ρ‖₊·K_j) (LipschitzWith.comp).
   (c) Let y ∈ M′, say y = φ(x) with x ∈ M. If x ∈ M₀, then y ∈ φ(M₀) = M₀′. Otherwise x = F_j(w) for some j and w, and y = F′_j(w) ∈ range F′_j. Hence M′ ⊆ M₀′ ∪ ⋃_j range F′_j, which is CountablyRectifiable k M′.

6. Field pos. For y = φ(x) ∈ M′ with x ∈ M, θ′(y) = θ(x) > 0, by (★) and hT.pos.

7. Field integrableOn. Let K be compact (K ⊆ univ).
   (a) M′ ∩ K = φ(M ∩ φ⁻¹(K)) (Set.image_inter_preimage).
   (b) φ⁻¹(K) is compact, because φ is the homeomorphism Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero ρ for ρ ≠ 0 (Homeomorph.isCompact_preimage).
   (c) By MeasurePreserving.integrableOn_image with (H2) and (H1), θ′ is μ-integrable on φ(M ∩ φ⁻¹K) iff θ′ ∘ φ = θ is (c • μ)-integrable on M ∩ φ⁻¹K. That is, Integrable θ ((c • μ)|_{M ∩ φ⁻¹K}), which equals Integrable θ (c • (μ|_{M ∩ φ⁻¹K})) (Measure.restrict_smul).
   (d) hT.integrableOn at the compact set φ⁻¹(K) ⊆ univ gives Integrable θ (μ|_{M ∩ φ⁻¹K}). Since c ≠ ∞, also Integrable θ (c • (μ|_{M ∩ φ⁻¹K})) (Integrable.smul_measure).
   By (a)–(d), θ′ is μ-integrable on M′ ∩ K.

8. Field aestronglyMeasurable. By Step 2, μ|_{M′} = map φ (c • (μ|_M)). For the measurable embedding φ, AEStronglyMeasurable ξ′ (map φ ν) ⟺ AEStronglyMeasurable (ξ′ ∘ φ) ν (MeasurableEmbedding.aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff). Also ξ′ ∘ φ = ξ by (★). hT.aestronglyMeasurable gives AEStronglyMeasurable ξ (μ|_M), hence also for c • (μ|_M) (AEStronglyMeasurable.smul_measure).

9. Field orients.
   By Step 2, μ|_{M′} = map φ (c • (μ|_M)). For the measurable embedding φ, (∀ᵐ y ∂ map φ ν, P y) ⟺ (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, P (φ x)) (MeasurableEmbedding.ae_map_iff). So it suffices to prove the orientation property P(φ x) of (M′, θ′, ξ′) for c • (μ|_M)-a.e. x.
   hT.orients holds μ|_M-a.e., hence c • (μ|_M)-a.e. (Measure.ae_smul_measure; filter_upwards). Fix such an x, with τ orthonormal, HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x (span(range τ)), and ξ(x) = ±simpleNVector τ. Use the same τ at φ(x) = ρ • x:
   (a) τ is orthonormal.
   (b) The sibling weighted_tangent, i.e. Submission.deformation_dilation_im_weightedTangent N k ρ M θ x (span(range τ)) hρ applied to the tangent hypothesis, gives HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M′ θ′ (ρ • x) (span(range τ)).
   (c) ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x) by (★), so ξ′(φ x) = simpleNVector τ or ξ′(φ x) = −simpleNVector τ.

10. Conclusion. Steps 3–9 establish all seven fields, so IsRectifiableTriple univ k M′ θ′ ξ′. ∎

theorem Submission.deformation_dilation_im_rectifiableTriple : ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M θ ξ → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) := by
  intro N k ρ M θ ξ hρ hemb hmp hT
  set φ : Eucl N → Eucl N := fun x => ρ • x with hφ
  set c : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k)
  have hinv : ∀ x, ρ⁻¹ • φ x = x := fun x => inv_smul_smul₀ hρ.ne' x
  have hnull : ∀ S : Set (Eucl N), (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) S = 0 →
      (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (φ '' S) = 0 := by
    intro S hS
    rw [← hmp.map_eq, hemb.map_apply, preimage_image_eq _ hemb.injective, Measure.smul_apply, hS,
      smul_zero]
  have hres : MeasurePreserving φ (c • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict M)
      ((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict (φ '' M)) := by
    rw [← Measure.restrict_smul]
    exact hmp.restrict_image_emb hemb M
  refine ⟨subset_univ _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hB := hT.nullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq
    rw [ae_eq_set] at hB
    refine (hemb.measurableSet_image.2
      (measurableSet_toMeasurable (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) M)).nullMeasurableSet.congr ?_
    rw [ae_eq_set, ← image_sdiff hemb.injective, ← image_sdiff hemb.injective]
    exact ⟨hnull _ hB.1, hnull _ hB.2⟩
  · obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀, F, hF, hMF⟩ := hT.countablyRectifiable
    have hφL : LipschitzWith ‖ρ‖₊ φ := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun a b => by
      show dist (ρ • a) (ρ • b) ≤ ‖ρ‖₊ * dist a b
      rw [dist_smul₀, coe_nnnorm]
    refine ⟨φ '' M₀, hnull M₀ hM₀, fun j => φ ∘ F j, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hF j
      exact ⟨‖ρ‖₊ * K, hφL.comp hK⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rcases hMF hy with hy₀ | hy₁
      · exact Or.inl (mem_image_of_mem φ hy₀)
      · obtain ⟨j, w, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hy₁
        exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, w, rfl⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    show 0 < θ (ρ⁻¹ • φ y)
    rw [hinv]
    exact hT.pos y hy
  · intro K hK _
    have hK' : IsCompact (φ ⁻¹' K) :=
      (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero ρ hρ.ne').isCompact_preimage.2 hK
    have hθ : (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ∘ φ = θ := funext fun y => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hinv]
    rw [← image_inter_preimage, hmp.integrableOn_image hemb, hθ, IntegrableOn,
      Measure.restrict_smul]
    exact Integrable.smul_measure (hT.integrableOn _ hK' (subset_univ _)) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  · have hξ : (fun y => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ∘ φ = ξ := funext fun y => by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hinv]
    rw [← hres.map_eq, hemb.aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff, hξ]
    exact hT.aestronglyMeasurable.smul_measure c
  · rw [← hres.map_eq, hemb.ae_map_iff]
    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_smul_measure hT.orients c] with y hy
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, htan, hξy⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨τ, hτ, Submission.deformation_dilation_im_weightedTangent N k ρ M θ y _ hρ htan, ?_⟩
    show ξ (ρ⁻¹ • φ y) = _ ∨ ξ (ρ⁻¹ • φ y) = _
    rw [hinv]
    exact hξy
proof_key_steps: (★) ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x) = x, so θ′ ∘ φ = θ and ξ′ ∘ φ = ξ.
From (H1) and (H2): μ(S) = 0 implies μ(φ S) = 0 (map_eq, MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply, preimage_image_eq).
From (H1) and (H2): φ is measure preserving from c • μ|_M to μ|_{φM} (restrict_smul, restrict_image_emb).
subset is trivial. nullMeasurableSet: measurable hull B = toMeasurable μ M, then image_sdiff and the null-set step. countablyRectifiable: φ(M₀) and φ ∘ F_j, with φ LipschitzWith ‖ρ‖₊. pos: by (★).
integrableOn: φM ∩ K = φ(M ∩ φ⁻¹K), φ⁻¹K is compact (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero), then integrableOn_image, restrict_smul, and Integrable.smul_measure with c ≠ ∞.
aestronglyMeasurable: μ|_{φM} = map φ (c • μ|_M), then aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff, ξ′ ∘ φ = ξ and smul_measure.
orients: ae_map_iff and ae_smul_measure. Keep the frame τ, transport the tangent plane with sibling weighted_tangent, and use ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x) = ±simpleNVector τ.
